scientific_integrity: Exact edge-orbit classification for connected unweighted complete split networks; rank-two Laplacian proof, algebraic certificate, and independent finite direct-matrix checks. No claim of independent external verification.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly two deleted edges of unit-conductance K_p join independent q, with \(p\ge3\) and \(q\ge2\). Does not extend to weighted or multiple-edge failures; a relevant 2024 paper on resistance in weighted complete split graphs was not obtainable in full, leaving residual originality risk.
title: A cubic runner-up transition in two-edge failures of complete split networks
